scope: Existing r4 32 chains only; read-only, no GPU, no rescoring or data generation
limits: Observed trace actions do not identify model cognition or counterfactual success.
Source version equality verified between fixtures; no fresh canonical source-version recomputation.
Receipts bind fixture and trace; no new crosswalk/admission/tensor audit; existing r4 audit remains authority.
Memory fact presence is semantic source comparison, not JSON parser acceptance; defects separately flagged.
No external migration/deployment execution, context compaction verification, or learned improvement.
